description: A Collie Client's hello, carrying the Daemon's token, refused with protocol_version_unsupported by a Daemon of an older protocol that cannot hand over, which ends the exchange (ADR 0098).

error.message: This Client speaks protocol 0.1, and this engine speaks 0.0: it accepts 0.0 to 0.0.

data.fix: Upgrade the engine to a version that speaks protocol 0.1, or use a Client of the engine's own version.
